about: The tooltip (ADR-0270): a series read at a position by its Series Kind — a level's value, a step's interval, a thinned pixel's range, a sampler's value and its Segment's method, an Interval's bounds, a candle and its volume — the nearest series when not all fit, an Observation's mark and an edge (ADR-0290, ADR-0300 to ADR-0304, ADR-0320, ADR-0321), from tests/ExChart.Engine.Tests (ComponentSupportTests, IntervalTests, PriceRangeTests, ScatterTests, ObservationIntervalTests, PointScaleTests, EdgeTests, ChartSpecTests).

cases.name: ADR-0270, ADR-0251: a level's value is the one handed in, through its format; between points there is none
ADR-0270: the lines are ordered top to bottom by their height, a line with no value last
ADR-0270: a level's missing value says so
ADR-0270: a series on the right axis stands at its height on that axis
ADR-0270, ADR-0253: a step names its interval
ADR-0253: a preceding step's first point holds at its own position only
ADR-0253: a preceding step's value holds over the interval up to its point
ADR-0253: past a step's last point there is no interval
ADR-0253: a following step's value holds from its point to the next
ADR-0253: a following step's last point holds at its own position only
ADR-0253: a following step reads nothing before its first point
ADR-0253: a step whose holding value is missing says so
ADR-0253: an Amount per period reads its amount, standing at the amount per year
ADR-0253: an Amount per period's first point bounds its first interval and holds no amount
ADR-0270, ADR-0254: a thinned pixel names its range and count, never one point as if it were the only one
ADR-0254: an Amount per period's thinned pixel has no single height

ADR-0254: a thinned pixel holding one point reads that point
ADR-0257: a sampled series reads its sampler's value, said as interpolated with its Segment's method
ADR-0257: an extrapolated range says so with its method

ADR-0257: past every Segment an Interpolated value is still said as interpolated
ADR-0257: outside its sampler's range a series has no value
ADR-0257: a quote inside a Segment says the method that covers it, and that it is quoted
ADR-0257: an Interpolated series of points says so, with no Segment to name
ADR-0257: an Interpolated step names its interval and its method
ADR-0303: the tooltip carries the bounds and their meaning
ADR-0303: a missing bound says the interval is missing
ADR-0303: a point with no bounds at all says the interval is missing, after its method
ADR-0300: the tooltip gives the four values, the change from the previous close and the volume

ADR-0300: a fall is said with its sign, and a candle with no volume says none
ADR-0300: an unchanged candle says so

ADR-0300: a change from a close of zero has no percentage
ADR-0302: a merged candle names its period and how many rows it holds
ADR-0302: a period the Consumer fixed is named even where it holds one row
ADR-0270: past what fits the plot, the nearest series are listed and the rest counted
ADR-0270: the series nearest the pointer are the ones listed
ADR-0270: the position is written as the axis writes it
ADR-0270: a hidden series is not read

ADR-0290: a merged mark of unnamed points says this one and the rest, at its position across
